edges.reason: msg.sender becomes owner in the constructor, granting the deployer all privileged rights
msg.sender is used as spender to require and decrement allowance in transferFrom
transfer forwards msg.sender as the _from argument of transferFrom
approve writes the allowance mapping keyed by msg.sender
delegate compares msg.sender against owner before delegating
msg.sender is the subject of the owner check guarding delegatecall
init is gated on msg.sender being the owner
batchSend is gated on msg.sender being the owner
setTradeAddress is gated on msg.sender being the owner
_from drives allowance, balance and whitelist checks in transferFrom
_from is checked against the owner/UNI/tradeAddress/canSale whitelist in ensure
_from indexes _onSaleNum when validating the per-address sale count
_to receives the credited balance in transferFrom
_to is forwarded unchanged from transfer to transferFrom
_value is the amount debited and credited in transferFrom
_value is subtracted from balanceOf without SafeMath
_value is added to balanceOf without SafeMath
_value is the per-recipient amount distributed by batchSend
_value is multiplied by _tos.length without SafeMath
balanceOf is read for the balance requirement and written for the debit and credit
allowance is read and decremented when msg.sender differs from _from
transferFrom requires the ensure whitelist gate to pass before updating balances
ensure delegates the sale condition verification to condition
ensure computes the _UNI pair address by calling pairFor
pairFor returns the pair address stored in the local _UNI
_saleNum limits how many times an address may sell
_onSaleNum is compared with _saleNum inside condition
_minSale lower bound is enforced inside condition
_maxSale upper bound is enforced inside condition
canSale whitelist lets listed addresses bypass the selling restrictions
tradeAddress is whitelisted in the ensure gate
the UNI router constant is whitelisted in the ensure gate
the computed _UNI pair address is whitelisted in the ensure gate
transfer delegates all logic to transferFrom
delegate executes an arbitrary delegatecall supplied by the owner
target address a is the destination of the delegatecall
arbitrary calldata b is passed verbatim to the delegatecall
delegatecall runs external code in this contract's storage context and can re-enter transferFrom
delegatecall can re-enter transfer before caller state settles
callOptionalReturn performs the low-level external call to the token
low-level call hands execution to a token whose fallback may re-enter token functions
_tos array is iterated to credit each recipient in batchSend
loop counter i bounds the iteration over _tos
the credited recipient balance is incremented without SafeMath
total is subtracted from the sender balance without SafeMath
_supply is multiplied by 10**decimals without SafeMath
decimals scales the constructor supply multiplication
constructor sets totalSupply to the scaled supply
constructor pre-approves the UNI router with an unlimited allowance
_name is stored as the token name in the constructor
_symbol is stored as the token symbol in the constructor
owner gate protects the delegate function
owner gate protects the init function
owner gate protects the batchSend function
owner gate protects the setTradeAddress function
addr parameter is assigned to the tradeAddress whitelist
setTradeAddress rewrites the whitelisted trading address
init writes _minSale from the token parameter
init writes _maxSale from the maxToken parameter
init writes _saleNum from the saleNum parameter
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] after a successful transfer

normalization_plan.reason: _from only exists as the source address argument of transferFrom/ensure/condition and should be folded into the transferFrom node
_to is the recipient argument consumed by transferFrom balance accounting
_value is the amount argument consumed by transferFrom balance accounting
_spender is only used inside approve for the allowance write
_tos is only used inside the batchSend recipient loop
target address a is only meaningful as the destination of the delegatecall operation
calldata b is only meaningful as the payload of the delegatecall operation
saleNum is only consumed by the init initializer
token is only consumed by the init initializer
maxToken is only consumed by the init initializer
addr is only consumed by the setTradeAddress setter
_name is only stored once by the constructor
_symbol is only stored once by the constructor
_supply is only used in the constructor supply multiplication
the local _UNI pair address is computed and consumed solely inside ensure
the local total feeds the unchecked sender balance subtraction in batchSend
the loop local recipient is only used inside the batchSend iteration
the loop counter is only used inside the batchSend iteration
